fact: The article states that the agreement to build the new civil status platform replacing MADANIA was signed on Friday 19 March 2021 with the consortium Inetum, DIGITECH France and IT SERV Company, and that the project is financed by the African Development Bank (BAD); the new platform is to connect health establishments for the registration of births and deaths, the courts and consular structures abroad.
title: Modernisation de la plateforme de l'Etat Civil "MADANIA" : Signature de l'accord avec un consortium
